name: 黃秀英
objective:
課程名稱：無人機技術與跨領域應用
在讓修習之學生能將無人機之工程技術與跨領域應用
相互融合，在工程分析面能配合跨領域應用之需求，並在應用面瞭解工程
之規範與要求。本課程內容包括無人機之飛行原理、無人機法規、無人機
飛控程控、無人機基本結構及動態、無人機通訊導航之基本工程分析技術、
及無人機應用；本課程並配合無人機業界單位之校外參訪，讓課堂所學能
與實務技術融合。本課程是以跨院合授的方式，由鐵道車輛技術研發中心、
車輛系、電子系、文化事業發展系之師資共同參與授課。

Course Title: Engineering Technology and Interdisciplinary Application for Drone
This course aims to provide students with the knowledge of engineering technology
and interdisciplinary applications for drones. The design of a drone should consider
both the engineering and interdisciplinary applications at the same time. A
designer should consider not only engineering regulations and requirements, but
also concepts of application. This course covers a basic introduction to drone
flight concepts, regulations, manual and programmed flight operation, basic
analysis of drone structures and dynamics, basic drone communication and
navigation, and drone applications. The industrial tour in this course helps
students to realize the theoretical and practical parts of drones. This course is
a joint lecture instructed by professional faculties from the Railway Vehicle
Research Center, Department of Vehicle Engineering, Department of Electronic Engineering, and Department of Cultural Vocation Development.
